ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher — the driver never entered the pickup radius and never pressed "I'm Here", so no cancellation fee was chargeable.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement 'I was on my way when the rider cancelled' [F8] asserts no rider no-show; the system record shows the driver was 2597 m away and never pressed 'I'm Here' [F1][F3][F4], so no NS-1 no-show fee could ever attach.
